collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After two friends make up after a quarrel, an elder wonders how distant people say sorry.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After two friends make up after a quarrel, (name1), an elder, wonders how distant people say sorry.

choices.label: Ask What Makes an Apology Real.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The friends imagine distant people saying sorry with gifts, words or shared meals.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A child imagines people who simply hug and say nothing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether apologies might be formal ceremonies in some places.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder says the words matter less than the changed behavior that follows.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees that meaning it matters most.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager says some apologies are not accepted right away, and that is all right too.
